description: Google's internal repository is the source of truth for this project. Copybara exports every change to GitHub, and imports approved pull requests so they can be reviewed internally.
Renovate only opens pull requests: once one is approved here, Copybara imports it, and the pull request closes when the change is exported back.

packageRules.description: Major updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, with one pull request each.
Never merge on GitHub: the next export from Google's repository would undo it.
